title_zh: 暂缓购买网球赛门票以等候天气更新

scenario.label_zh: 暂缓购买网球赛门票以等候天气更新
scenario.goal_zh: 核对赛事因天气暂停时的观众安排，并决定暂不付款购票、等待天气更新

context_zh: 虚构网球赛事售票咨询：访客询问观众票及恶劣天气安排。
author: author-phase09-b

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: Is this tennis tournament suitable for someone who's never watched a sporting event in person?

sentences.speaker: Receptionist Jo
sentences.text: Certainly. A spectator ticket gives you access to the outdoor courts and the covered seating area.

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: The final looks spectacular in the photographs. But what happens if there's heavy rain?

sentences.speaker: Receptionist Jo
sentences.text: The officials may suspend play. Spectators can wait in the covered area, but we can't promise when play will resume.

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: So buying a ticket doesn't guarantee I'll see a full match tomorrow.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist Jo
sentences.text: That's right. The weather update will be posted at six this evening. You haven't paid for the ticket yet.

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: Then I'll wait for that update before deciding whether to buy.
